moments.title: Strictly & Bake Off Back on Screens
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest feel-good shows, Strictly Come Dancing and The Great British Bake Off, are expected to return to screens this week, kicking off the autumn TV schedule.

source.l: UK TV Guides / General knowledge of seasonal programming

angles.name: Strictly buzz
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter, glamour, and maybe a few dropped lifts! Strictly Come Dancing is back to brighten up your autumn evenings. Who's your favourite to win this year?

angles.name: Bake Off treats
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off tent is open for business. We're ready for some showstopper bakes (and maybe a few soggy bottoms).

angles.name: Autumn TV double bill
angles.copy: Autumn TV is officially here with the return of Strictly and Bake Off! Which one are you settling down to watch first?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Approaching
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, is just around the corner, bringing shorter days and cooler temperatures.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Crisper air, golden leaves, and pumpkin spice everything! The Autumn Equinox is coming next week, officially ushering in the season of cosiness. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Seasonal change
angles.copy: The days are getting shorter, and autumn is on its way! Next week marks the Autumn Equinox. Time to dig out those jumpers!
